title: いっしょにがんばろう (Issho ni Gambaro)
description: When the class is asked to prepare a performance for the school festival, everything goes wrong — arguments, forgotten lines, stage fright, and a broken prop. But through teamwork, kindness, and not giving up, the children discover that doing something together is more meaningful than doing it perfectly. A long story about perseverance, cooperation, and belonging.
author: オリジナル
